script.greeting: Hello. This is a call from {org_name} about {event_name}.
script.prompt: You are invited to {event_name} on {date} at {venue}. Press one to confirm, two to decline, or three to reschedule. You can also say your answer after the beep.
script.reprompt: Sorry, I did not catch that. Please press one to confirm, two to decline, or three to reschedule.
script.ack_confirm: Thank you. Your attendance is confirmed.
script.ack_decline: Thank you. We have noted that you cannot attend.
script.ack_reschedule: Thank you. We will contact you about another time.
script.ack_call_later: Thank you. We will call you again later.
script.ack_stop: Understood. We will not call you again.
script.ack_unclear: Sorry, we could not record your response. We may try again later.
script.voicemail: Hello, this is {org_name} inviting you to {event_name} on {date}. Please call us back to confirm.
